plugins.name: @local/notes-panel
plugins.description: Harness Web UI 笔记面板：直接编辑渲染后的 Markdown，支持表格、图片、自动保存、插件版本日志和版本化分享快照。

plugins.name: @local/facechat-recorder
plugins.description: Face-to-face conversation recorder panel: near-real-time transcription, automatic speaker separation with merge correction, a transcript glossary for technical terms, identity-aware summaries, model preparation and Markdown export.

plugins.name: @local/chat-room
plugins.description: Message list for the Harness Web UI: every installation owns one inbox topic, so an add code is simply its id — paste the other person's code and start chatting. The Host half bridges both DSH instances through a public relay, so people on different networks can talk without exposing a port or signing up.

plugins.name: @local/pomodoro-timer
plugins.description: Ambient pomodoro timer below the message composer.

plugins.name: @local/exploration-atlas
plugins.description: A clear system map of DSH exploration: six causal stages, seven capability dimensions, real evidence, and next experiments.

plugins.name: @local/resource-api
plugins.description: Unified device-side resource interface for Harness plugins: one resource.search / resource.read API over every plugin that registers a Provider, so notes, transcripts and messages become one addressable space.

plugins.name: @local/knowledge-context-reference
plugins.description: Global # references for asking DeepSeek Harness about local Notes and Facechat content.

plugins.name: @local/quick-ask
plugins.description: Option+7 Quick Ask for DSH, with macOS cross-app activation and opt-in, previewable foreground accessibility context.

plugins.name: @local/loop-trajectory
plugins.description: A compact horizontal view of the current DeepSeek Harness agent loop, projected from the official ui-trajectory session data.

plugins.name: @local/verify-before-finish
plugins.description: Adds a Verify-before-Finish stage to the default agent loop: a turn that changed files without verification evidence is sent back for one more step.

plugins.name: @local/access-auto-approval
plugins.description: Automatically approves DSH access requests, delegating plugin removal to the user.

plugins.name: @local/self-iteration
plugins.description: 自驱动迭代：读取「消息」里收到的 DSH 插件反馈，自动生成迭代需求，用创造模式的主 Agent 完成迭代，并把迭代记录以「自驱动」来源写进对应插件的笔记。
